+## LLM-Friendly Output Extensions
+
+By default, section outputs use these extensions:
+
+- XML: `.xml.txt`
+- JSON: `.json.txt`
+- Markdown: `.md`
+- Plain text: `.txt`
+
+This keeps uploads frictionless across stricter web-based LLM file handlers.
+You can override any of them in `cx.toml`:
+
+```toml
+[output.extensions]
+xml = ".xml.txt"
+json = ".json.txt"
+markdown = ".md"
+plain = ".txt"
+```
+

+## Output Extensions
+
+`cx` names section output files using style-specific extensions configured in `[output.extensions]`.
+
+Defaults:
+
+```toml
+[output.extensions]
+xml = ".xml.txt"
+json = ".json.txt"
+markdown = ".md"
+plain = ".txt"
+```
+
+Rules:
+
+- Each value must be a non-empty string.
+- Each value must start with `.`.
+- Path separators (`/` or `\\`) are not allowed.
+
+Example:
+
+```toml
+[output.extensions]
+xml = ".xml.bundle.txt"
+json = ".json.bundle.txt"
+markdown = ".md"
+plain = ".txt"
+```
+
